description: Erection of a lower ground floor rear extension including underpinning the existing outrigger foundations; installation of external plant and associated enclosures including associated external pipework/rainwater goods; and associated hard and soft landscaping, groundworks, excavation and level changes to the rear garden; alterations to existing outrigger door and window openings at ground floor level; alteration of the rear lower ground floor window opening to form a doorway and associated external level adjustments; works to rear garden boundary walls including repair/reinforcement and associated trellis works; alterations to the front garden lightwell at lower ground floor level including formation of a new external door with new glazed canopy, installation and alteration of railings, and formation of new external steps with cycle ramp. Also linked to full application ref: p2026/0670/ful.
